name: PIJAlance Push Notifications
author: pijalance

sections.description:
Ping lets readers subscribe to your website with one tap. When you publish a post, they get a browser notification with your headline, excerpt and featured image, on Android, Windows, Mac, Linux and iPhone (iOS 16.4 and later, once added to the Home Screen).

Ping is built by PIJAlance Magazine, an independent newsroom, for its own readers, and is now open to every publisher.

Features

  • Free for up to 5,000 subscribers per website.
  • Automatic alerts when you publish a post, or send alerts by hand from your dashboard.
  • A polite, branded invitation that never nags readers who say “Not now”.
  • Delivery and click statistics for every alert.
  • AI help in your dashboard: three headline options from your post, best time to send, and A/B tests.
  • Fact-checks and translation (Nigerian Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo) on paid plans.
  • Every alert is screened for scams and harmful content, protecting your readers and your brand.
  • No reader profiles and no selling of data.

How it works

  1. Create a free account at ping.pijalance.com and add your website.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to Settings, PIJAlance Push Notifications, and paste your site key and API key.
  4. Publish a post. Subscribers are alerted automatically.

External services

This plugin connects to Ping, a web push notification service operated by PIJAlance Magazine Limited at https://ping.pijalance.com. It is needed to collect subscriptions and deliver notifications.

  • On the public pages of your site, the plugin loads the subscribe script from https://ping.pijalance.com/sdk.js. When a visitor agrees to receive notifications, their browser’s push subscription (an anonymous address provided by the browser) and their browser language are sent to Ping so alerts can be delivered. No name, email or other personal details are sent.
  • Your site’s /ping-sw.js file loads https://ping.pijalance.com/sw.js, the service worker that displays notifications.
  • When a post is published for the first time and automatic alerts are on, the plugin sends the post’s title, a short excerpt, its link and featured image address to https://ping.pijalance.com/api/v1/notify, using your private API key.

Terms of use: https://ping.pijalance.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://ping.pijalance.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Create a free account at ping.pijalance.com and add your website.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New, Upload Plugin, and choose the PIJAlance Push Notifications ZIP file. Install and activate it.
  3. Go to Settings, PIJAlance Push Notifications.
  4. Paste the site key and the API key shown on your website’s page in the Ping dashboard, and save.
  5. Publish a post. Everyone who subscribed is alerted automatically.

To send an alert without publishing a post, use the Ping dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is Ping free?

Yes. The free plan covers up to 5,000 subscribers per website and 30 alerts a day. Paid plans add higher limits and more AI tools.

Does it work on iPhone?

Yes, on iOS 16.4 and later, once the reader adds your website to their Home Screen. This is Apple’s rule for every web push service.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The subscribe script is small and loads asynchronously, after your page.

Can I send an alert without publishing a post?

Yes, from your Ping dashboard, or from your own system with the Ping API.

  • First release.
